summary: Final Season (our 25-48; two Netflix ONA batches, AniList 136880 = 25-36 released 2024-12-05, AniList 187267 = 37-48 released 2026-03-07) adapts the rest of the manga, chapters 100-196 / volumes 12-22, and ep 48 ends on ch 196 (v22) - flag #854 verified by the fandom Third_Season page, WDTALO and the ch-196 synopsis (police interrupting the proposal). The adaptation is a wholesale restructure rather than a linear one: Part 1 runs the Legoshi mainline 100-141 roughly in order but interleaves later material (119, 136-138, 143, 145, 147, 156, 157) and plays 113-114 before Gosha's 104-107; Part 1 ends mid-ch 141 (Legoshi thrown into the sea). Part 2 covers 141-196 in 12 episodes by relocating the Jack (152-154), B-Strike (123), Bill/chick (155), Gosha/Toki (189) and Melon-mother (162) chapters, keeping the quiz (167-168), turf war (172-179), Melon's self-shooting (191) and the 193-196 epilogue, while cutting Kyuu (159-161, 186), Ogma's death (165) and Melon's father (188) and adding anime-original threads (Dorin's murder, Zoolympics/artificial meat, Legoshi framed, ep 44 entirely original). 23 anchors produced (all canon/mixed episodes except 44); 6 high (25, 28, 29, 36, 37, 38, plus 48's endpoint), the rest medium; no repairs to stored data.
